snippet.title: Red Frame trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Red Frame by ⁨@basenjigames is a first-person exploration puzzle game in which you navigate the sprawling rooms of a hyperreal mansion buried beneath the earth. Solve intricate puzzles shaped by those who once lived there, and discover the mechanism preserving a family's legacy.
